title: Parkour Godot: The Great Woodland
counts_note: Variants and placements are estimates, not completed assets.

items.name: Editable terrain source
items.acceptance: Native + Web pilot, region seams, no unsupported streaming claim

items.name: Baked terrain fallback
items.planned_population: 16 region meshes, subdivided only as profiling requires
items.delivery: Mesh resources/GLB, import settings, simplified colliders
items.acceptance: Same height samples, seams, palette and routes as Terrain3D

items.name: Cliff/outcrop modules
items.origin: Adapt CC0 rock donors; custom silhouette gaps
items.acceptance: No snagging ledges; no overhang inferred from heightmap

items.name: Distant ridge silhouettes
items.origin: New simple meshes or adapt cleared donors
items.acceptance: Beyond boundary, no collision/route promise, consistent skyline

items.name: River channel and banks
items.planned_population: ~1.0-1.2 km visual watercourse, broken into 6 reaches
items.delivery: Curves, bank meshes and river sections
items.acceptance: Walkable banks, no water/terrain gaps, no fluid simulation claim

items.name: River surface
items.acceptance: Compatibility WebGL2; no refraction, SSR or expensive simulation

items.name: Waterfall and foam receiver
items.origin: New simple meshes; licensed texture only if needed
items.delivery: Ribbon mesh, opaque/light alpha material, low preset
items.acceptance: Read at distance, no flicker, low-motion mode

items.name: Terrain height/control/color data
items.delivery: Source maps, checksums and import recipe
items.acceptance: No precision loss at landings; save/load equality

items.name: Boundary and recovery envelope
items.delivery: Versioned bounds, safe volumes, fall plane
items.acceptance: Every accessible edge and high point inside profile

items.name: Trail and ramp adapters
items.origin: Custom fit; optional Road Generator bake after spike
items.acceptance: Ground path normally <=15 deg; joins below step threshold

items.name: Short step/stair family
items.acceptance: No riser > current 0.25 m step aid; ordinary input in both directions

items.name: Launch ledge family
items.delivery: Broad slab/root forms + named launch marker
items.acceptance: Takeoff view and ground anchor visible; no blind lip

items.name: Landing slab family
items.delivery: 3/5/8/12 m planning widths, separate flat collision
items.acceptance: Use measured landing dispersion and wing span, not nominal width alone

items.name: Lower recovery shelves
items.delivery: Broad connected meshes and return route markers
items.acceptance: Ordinary fall -> safe shelf or prompt respawn; no soft lock

items.name: Root/stone seam adapters
items.delivery: Visual seam caps + collision seam checks
items.acceptance: No small ledges, camera traps or hidden gaps

items.name: Bridge deck/rail modules
items.origin: Adapt existing root-bridge cue; custom exact spans
items.delivery: Root and pale-stone decks; railing optional
items.acceptance: 4 m main-deck starting width; tested camera and capsule clearance

items.name: Stepping stone family
items.origin: Adapt stock forms with custom flat tops
items.acceptance: Optional route; miss drops onto recovery bank

items.name: Grounded causeway alternative
items.acceptance: Accessible alternate to water and glide gaps

items.name: Switchback and bank connectors
items.acceptance: Grounded route remains continuous throughout map

items.name: Large root arch family
items.origin: Adapt existing look; custom metric openings
items.acceptance: Opening >= measured wing/camera envelope + margin

items.name: Hero Heartwood tree
items.origin: Custom trunk/roots using Cosmo canopy or authored mesh
items.delivery: Editable source; roots and platforms separate
items.acceptance: Hero roots are collision, foliage is not; distinct from scatter trees

items.name: Fallen logs and hollow forms
items.origin: Adapt CC0 donors or existing study
items.delivery: GLBs; only tagged traversal logs collide
items.acceptance: No mandatory cramped tunnels; chase camera remains usable

items.name: Retaining walls/terraces
items.acceptance: Matches landing palette and slope support, no hidden collision

items.name: Ruined arch family
items.origin: Adapt CC0 if exact suitable files pass; else custom
items.delivery: Whole, broken and summit arch GLBs
items.acceptance: Wide readable openings; no extra castle/temple scope

items.name: Pillars and capstones
items.acceptance: Occlusion and camera checks, no accidental route blockers

items.name: Ruined floor/stair court
items.acceptance: Collision edges align, grounded alternative through ruins

items.name: Low brook bridge/abutments
items.acceptance: Natural river crossing, clearance and bank alignment

items.name: Woodland Cosmo tree set
items.delivery: Original seeds + three LOD meshes + MIT notices
items.acceptance: Exact 4.8-beta2 Web render, batch adapter and silhouette review

items.name: Additional grove silhouettes
items.origin: Adapt CC0 only if existing three look repetitive
items.delivery: Three approved tree variants with LOD
items.acceptance: One palette/scale; no new pack imported wholesale

items.name: Sapling/scrub clumps
items.origin: Existing inputs: Cosmo sapling; new clump adaptations proposed, CC0 donors not inspected
items.status: EXISTING INPUTS / ADAPTATION OR FIXTURE PROPOSED
items.acceptance: No corridor occlusion; no collision on dressing

items.name: Shrub family
items.acceptance: Rights/file/import review and batching

items.name: Grass clumps
items.acceptance: No individual blades, no alpha-heavy field, no landing-edge cover

items.name: Ferns and broadleaf clumps
items.acceptance: Consistent scale; near-only density budget

items.name: Flowers/mushrooms
items.acceptance: Optional dressing only; no collection mechanic implied

items.name: Moss/root trim and hanging vines
items.acceptance: Pale landing lip stays uncovered; no misleading grab surface

items.name: Boulder/rock family
items.acceptance: Colliders only for route/support rocks, not every pebble

items.name: Small stone/pebble clusters
items.acceptance: Batched, no tiny colliders or route clutter

items.name: River reeds/bank foliage
items.acceptance: No water/landing occlusion; culled before distant glides

items.name: Stumps, deadwood and root accents
items.origin: Cleared CC0 or reuse existing study
items.acceptance: No obstruction of collision-safe corridor

items.name: Leaf-litter groups
items.origin: New flat low-poly groups or CC0
items.acceptance: No z-fighting; optional low preset removal

items.name: Ground detail patches
items.acceptance: No renderer-specific decals required

items.name: Ruins debris clusters
items.acceptance: No duplicate colliders, no confusing false landings

items.name: Terrain palette/material set
items.planned_population: Grass, soil, pale stone, rock, riverbed, moss
items.origin: New solid palette; CC0 texture optional
items.acceptance: 512 px default if textured; mipmaps and actual import verified

items.name: Bark/leaf shared materials
items.origin: Existing Cosmo solid colors; match woodland
items.acceptance: Opaque, no source textures silently added

items.name: Water/foam material set
items.acceptance: Bounded transparency, no unsupported screen effects

items.name: Spawn/finish plinth and markers
items.origin: Adapt existing finish cue; new metric forms
items.acceptance: Grounded finish, clear feedback; preserve reset/falls semantics

items.name: Checkpoint anchor scenes
items.origin: New system, not in current candidate
items.delivery: ID, volume, grounded rule, respawn pose, map revision
items.acceptance: Order, duplicates, wrong-height, respawn and reset tests

items.name: Route signs/arrows
items.acceptance: No color-only route identity; legible from actual camera

items.name: Practice interaction and control cues
items.acceptance: Keyboard readable; optional hints, not modal interruption

items.name: Bounded updraft volumes and cues
items.origin: New data-driven version of existing concept
items.delivery: Area3D/data, start/end heights, vector, cue mesh/audio
items.acceptance: Dive cancels lift; exits, ceiling and network parity; not cosmetic lift

items.name: Recovery/fall volumes
items.delivery: Fall plane, exclusion volumes and safe pose validation
items.acceptance: No full-map origin respawn after every miss; no respawn loop

items.name: Route/map data resources
items.delivery: Stable IDs, ordered anchors, rules and revision hash
items.acceptance: Ground bypass cannot finish skipped route; free roam still allowed

items.name: Current fox/Angel/woodland originals
items.acceptance: No automatic replacement; reference and rollback

items.name: Fox locomotion integration candidate
items.origin: Existing lab/baseline inputs; selection and new game integration/manifest proposed
items.status: EXISTING INPUTS / ADAPTATION OR FIXTURE PROPOSED
items.acceptance: No sliding, loop pop, wing clipping or shared-skeleton state

items.name: Fox action clips
items.planned_population: Idle, walk, run, launch/climb, glide, dive, land
items.origin: Adapt owned clips; custom missing transitions
items.acceptance: Current states drive visuals; animation cannot move authority collider

items.name: Wing/socket and clearance fixture
items.planned_population: 1 tested active wing plus envelope data
items.origin: Existing Angel input; new socket/clearance fixture proposed, no new wing selection
items.status: EXISTING INPUTS / ADAPTATION OR FIXTURE PROPOSED
items.delivery: Socket transform, clearance volume, test scene
items.acceptance: All camera/pose/landing transitions with actual wing span

items.name: Other owned animal readiness
items.planned_population: Rabbit, raccoon, squirrel, deer optional later
items.acceptance: Not required for first map; no fox gait blindly retargeted; rights separately cleared

items.name: Route selection and progress
items.origin: New UI using existing menu style
items.delivery: Route name, difficulty, progress, reset state
items.acceptance: No invented multiplayer/leaderboard status; small screen tested

items.name: Checkpoint/recovery/finish feedback
items.origin: Adapt existing results; add honest route states
items.acceptance: Time/falls preserved on recovery; Run again clears consistently

items.name: Map/orientation and landmark legend
items.acceptance: Keyboard dismissal, no compulsory minimap or GPS scope

items.name: Settings and reduced-motion cues
items.delivery: Density preset, camera sensitivity, cue motion/audio toggles
items.acceptance: Preserve current controls; no color-only or motion-only information

items.name: Forest/wind/river ambience
items.origin: Reuse owned or specifically cleared CC0 recordings
items.acceptance: Audition loops, no abrupt seam; mute works

items.name: Footstep/landing/wing cues
items.acceptance: Mix under ambience; no sound required to navigate

items.name: Start/checkpoint/recovery/finish cues
items.acceptance: No repeated retrigger spam; reset cleans playback

items.name: Wind/leaf/checkpoint cues
items.acceptance: Compatibility export + repeated pause/reset cleanup

items.name: Zone/foliage scene manifests
items.planned_population: 64 x 128 m authoring sectors; 32 m instancer cells
items.acceptance: Repeatable generation; no landing decoration drift

items.name: Collision and route fixtures
items.planned_population: One metric test scene + per-zone seam cases
items.delivery: Capsule/camera/wing fixture, route replay and sample checks
items.acceptance: Both directions, max glide speed, cell boundary, recovery

items.name: Web/native build profiles
items.origin: New configuration derived from current baseline
items.acceptance: No-thread/extension match, no missing WASM, no production host change

items.name: Performance fixture and evidence
items.acceptance: Actual browser/device captures, not headless timings

items.name: Licence/source/import register
items.delivery: URLs, author, license text, hash, units, pivots, LOD, clips
items.acceptance: Complete before import approval or sharing; no unclear-rights downloads

items.delivery: Shared bounds, collision/map ID, checkpoint rules, peer tests
